epoch_policy: Every method accounts for each baseline receiver/UTC epoch; rejected, failed, and inapplicable rows remain explicit.
baseline_binding: handoff-0001.json binds the frozen 10 MS/s panel member to the second direction-A track export; native-window measurement inputs remain pending.
frequency_policy: Alternatives refine the acquisition-bound CFO basin and cannot select a different OFDM alias.
mask_policy: Use the baseline support mask unchanged; do not add epochs discovered by an alternative.
failure_policy: A missing method row invalidates the comparison.
waveform_applicability: Known-pilot comparison requires detected pilot evidence plus acquisition-qualified timing and CFO alias support at each epoch; sample rate alone is insufficient.
remaining_input_contract: immutable source sample/native-window identity per observation
absolute UTC support and receiver/visit/probe identity
detected pilot edge and acquisition-qualified frame epoch
absolute CFO alias/basin and bounded residual interval
baseline support/rejection diagnostics and frozen held-window mapping
read-only bounded samples or equivalently bound matched-pilot matrices
downstream: No waveform comparison, model fit, scoring, or downstream position fitting is authorized by this handoff.
